title: Null on every vanishing relatively compact open set implies null off the support
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, let U ⊆ ℝ^P be any set, let T ∈ D_n(U) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U n), let M ⊆ ℝ^P with M ⊆ U, and let μ be any measure on ℝ^P (Eucl P). Suppose μ(M ∩ W) = 0 for every W ⊆ ℝ^P such that W is open, closure W is compact, closure W ⊆ U and T vanishes on W (T.VanishesOn W: T(ω) = 0 for every ω ∈ Dⁿ(U) with tsupport ω ⊆ W). Then μ(M ∖ spt T) = 0. Here spt T = T.support = U ∖ T.zeroRegion, and T.zeroRegion is the union of all such W.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Eucl P)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (M : Set (Eucl P)) (μ : Measure (Eucl P)), M ⊆ U → (∀ W : Set (Eucl P), IsOpen W → IsCompact (closure W) → closure W ⊆ U → T.VanishesOn W → μ (M ∩ W) = 0) → μ (M \ T.support) = 0
